scope: Rustman local authorized audit. RCE testing excluded. No real secrets.

cases.title: Plaintext local secret payloads
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Pre-fix test exposed environment plaintext. Post-fix env/history/raw disk/reopen and migration/tamper tests passed. AES-GCM payload encryption is implemented, not full-database encryption. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes. Native production keychain-module smoke check also PASSED on Windows: create/read 256-bit synthetic key, trusted migration-state roundtrip, and deletion verified. No real credential values or user DB accessed.
cases.next_step: Native full-app isolated UI smoke, recovery/backup UX, cross-platform keystores/permissions, whole-file replacement/rollback limits, plaintext Git/export/temp artifacts remain outside this verified payload-encryption boundary.

cases.next_step: Positive same-origin redirect and downgrade/port matrix; full requester suite.

cases.title: Updater lacks enforced release authenticity

cases.next_step: Configure real release public key, offline/protected signing procedure and signed integration fixtures. Never commit private key.

cases.title: Collection ID used as filesystem path
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Portable ASCII ID allowlist rejects traversal, separators, absolute/drive/UNC paths, dots, encoded traversal, reserved Windows names, NUL and Unicode/confusable IDs. Full batch validation rejects case-insensitive duplicates before writes. VCS containment/staging suite: 3 passed. Unicode display names remain supported. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Maintain regression matrix; final full suite after review fixes. Snapshot destinations reject links/non-regular files, writes use exclusive randomized staging and rename.

cases.title: Cleanup deletes unrelated JSON files
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Writer deletes only recognized collection snapshots whose IDs match filenames, preserves unrelated JSON, validates destination collisions and refuses overwrites. Three focused VCS tests passed. Review regression SEC-026 remains to repair for oversized/binary unrelated JSON. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Resolve SEC-026 and verify again; do not claim all unrelated-file cases are closed yet.

cases.title: Broad Git staging includes unrelated secrets
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: After cleanup fix, isolated regression demonstrated private.txt entered a commit from preexisting staging. Commit now builds an independent index from HEAD plus recognized snapshots, preserving unrelated staging. Post-fix VCS suite: 3 passed. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Add retained HEAD/deletion/conflict edge tests and complete final full suite. SEC-013 inline credentials in recognized snapshots is separate and still OPEN.

cases.title: Inline request credentials serialized to Git/export
cases.status: Source-confirmed; OPEN
cases.evidence: SavedRequest includes bearer/basic/API-key/cookie/JWT values; full clones are serialized without redaction. AES protection of SQLite does not protect these files.
cases.next_step: Separate explicit export semantics from shared Git publication; guard/redact with local data preservation and tests.

cases.title: Mutable GitHub Action references
cases.status: Source-confirmed exposure; no compromise demonstrated
cases.evidence: checkout@v4, rust-toolchain@stable, rust-cache@v2 and action-gh-release@v2 are mutable refs; release jobs have contents:write.
cases.next_step: Resolve reviewed upstream commits, pin full SHAs, restrict workflow permissions and use locked dependency builds.

cases.title: Dependency identity / typosquatting review
cases.status: Inventory only; INCONCLUSIVE
cases.evidence: 766 locked packages, registry checksums present, no non-ASCII package names; two Git sources under rust-man-org locked to exact commit. These facts do not establish trusted ownership or absence of malicious code.
cases.next_step: Capture inventory; verify direct crate identities and Git commit provenance; review transitives/build scripts and registry policy.

cases.title: Dependency advisory audit tooling unavailable
cases.status: Alternative RustSec scan completed; CLI install remains unavailable
cases.evidence: 0.21.2 cannot parse CVSS 4.0 advisory. Installing 0.22.2 failed in aws-lc-sys native compilation. No successful current advisory report yet. Official RustSec 0.33.0 library with default features disabled successfully scanned the local advisory DB and Cargo.lock; report saved in rustsec-report.json: 2 vulnerability matches, 13 unmaintained warnings, 1 unsound warning.
cases.next_step: Preserve reproducible helper source/report and triage dependency reachability. Do not describe the report as a clean audit.

cases.title: Import scan queues entries before bounding traversal
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: visited > 2048 is checked on pop, but read_dir pushes arbitrary eligible children without pending-size check. File sizes are capped; directory enumeration/queue may exceed intended entry cap. Both folder readers can enumerate arbitrarily many ignored files without counting them toward entry limits. A bounded fixture with 2049 empty ignored files was added; result pending. Red test failed on 2049 empty ignored files. Both scan paths now count discovered entries including ignored children before enqueueing; test passed. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Complete final full/default-disabled/native checks and cross-platform/native UI review; retain case-specific limitations above.

cases.title: Secrets visible after decryption / missing output redaction
cases.status: Known auth/cookie display and diagnostic paths hardened; broader output policy remains OPEN
cases.source: Cookie/auth/environment UI; snippet; clipboard; logs; export
cases.evidence: Pre-fix console test leaked synthetic cookie/bearer. Post-fix exact-known-value redaction passed while original request cookie remained unchanged. Auth inputs now secure=true; response cookie/sensitive-header views mask values; manually entered sensitive request headers use secure cells with no plaintext oversized preview. Regression run excluding then-open Git tests: 348 passed, 3 ignored. Review found response-only and newly scripted header values need additional handling (SEC-025). Clipboard/export/bulk/raw response paths are not declared closed.
cases.next_step: Resolve SEC-025, review explicit reveal/copy/export/bulk/raw body boundaries and add native visual verification. Redaction is known-value/name-based, not a guarantee against arbitrary encoded or split secrets.

cases.title: quick-xml duplicate-attribute CPU exhaustion advisory
cases.severity: High upstream; Rustman reachability limited to build path identified
cases.status: Lockfile match confirmed; OPEN
cases.evidence: Official RustSec report matched RUSTSEC-2026-0194; fixed >=0.41.0. Current calamine uses quick-xml 0.42.0 and plist uses 0.41.0. Runtime response exploitation is not established. No exhaustion payload run.
cases.next_step: Review upstream wayland-scanner upgrade/backport and build-time XML trust boundaries; preserve full report.

cases.title: quick-xml namespace allocation exhaustion advisory
cases.severity: High upstream; application exploitability not demonstrated
cases.status: Dependency match retained; affected API not found in identified consumer
cases.evidence: RustSec RUSTSEC-2026-0195 requires NsReader/NamespaceResolver paths. Dependency presence alone does not prove that wayland-scanner invokes that affected API. Fixed >=0.41.0. No OOM test run. Source inspection: wayland-scanner parse.rs imports plain Reader; no NsReader or NamespaceResolver use found. Thus the identified consumer does not establish the advisory-specific affected path.
cases.next_step: Inspect actual quick-xml APIs used by wayland-scanner; triage build-only/reachability separately from presence.

cases.title: Transitive lru panic-safety unsoundness advisory
cases.status: Dependency warning retained; documented trigger not supported by identified key type
cases.evidence: RUSTSEC-2026-0253 warning requires unwinding/catch_unwind and a key with potentially panicking Drop. Rustman direct lru is 0.18.5; release profile panic=abort. Do not claim RCE or demonstrated memory corruption in Rustman. cryoglyph uses LruCache<cosmic_text::CacheKey,...>; cosmic-text 0.15.0 CacheKey derives Copy. This key cannot implement the panicking Drop required by the advisory. No runtime exploitability established.
cases.next_step: Review cryoglyph key/drop usage and upstream replacement/upgrade. RCE tests remain excluded.

cases.title: Unmaintained dependency notices
cases.severity: Maintenance risk, not proof of exploitable vulnerability
cases.status: 13 report entries captured; triage pending
cases.evidence: Notices include bincode, paste, pin-utils, rustybuzz, ttf-parser, unsafe-libyaml, yaml-rust, zbus_names and zvariant families. Some notices repeat across versions. Includes dependencies introduced by native-keyring integration.
cases.next_step: Map platform/runtime/build reachability and upstream migrations; do not count notices as 13 proven security exploits.

cases.title: Unavailable database can trigger empty Git snapshot writes
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Boot failure (including missing/locked OS keychain) sets db=None and empty state; Git refresh still writes that empty collection list/global script pair. The managed writer can remove real snapshots. This was possible for baseline SQLite errors; keychain dependency adds a normal failure trigger. New test asserts no Git task is scheduled when db=None; result pending. Red test scheduled one task when db=None; handler now returns no tasks and preserves commit input. UI hides Git controls while storage unavailable; regression passed. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Complete final full/default-disabled/native checks and cross-platform/native UI review; retain case-specific limitations above.

cases.title: Deleted migration marker can authorize plaintext reinjection
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Migration trusts absence of local_vault.format. Removing that row and inserting plaintext into an already encrypted DB causes it to be encrypted and accepted with legitimate key. New regression requires failure; result pending. Red downgrade test failed as predicted. Completion flag now resides in separate OS credential metadata; missing DB format after completion and mixed legacy states are rejected. Synthetic-key regression passed. This does not authenticate the entire database or prevent whole-file replacement/rollback; native OS metadata smoke test remains open. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Per-payload authentication and trusted migration marker are verified; this is not whole-database rollback/replacement protection. Native marker lifecycle passed on Windows; cross-platform integration remains.

cases.title: Response-only and newly scripted auth secrets bypass log redaction
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Current redactor gathers tab/env secrets only. Response-only Set-Cookie values passed in HostInput and new SetHeader Authorization values are not included; logs can expose them. New synthetic regression added; result pending. Red test printed response-only cookie. Redactor now collects sensitive HostInput header/cookie values and new sensitive SetHeader effects. Regression passed while actual extra header remains original. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Complete final full/default-disabled/native checks and cross-platform/native UI review; retain case-specific limitations above.

cases.title: Bounded managed-file reader rejects unrelated oversized/binary JSON
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Independent review found eager reading before ownership recognition. Added bounded test with sparse 32 MiB+1 unrelated JSON and 2-byte non-UTF8 JSON; test failed on UTF-8 read. These files must be preserved and ignored rather than blocking valid collection operations. Managed discovery now reads bounded bytes and ignores oversized/invalid JSON. Explicit destination collision refusal remains. Regression passed. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Complete final full/default-disabled/native checks and cross-platform/native UI review; retain case-specific limitations above.

cases.title: Masked snippet preview and unmasked clipboard action differ
cases.status: Label clarified; original-value copy remains explicit
cases.evidence: Panel Copy resolves real environment/credential values while preview is masked. Tooltip/status now explicitly say unmasked; cURL export label likewise. Explicit copy is an intentional secret export, not an encryption bypass.
cases.next_step: Consider a separate copy-redacted action; review clipboard retention policy without silently breaking runnable exports.

cases.title: Bulk header editor reveals secure-cell values
cases.status: Explicit editing boundary; label clarified
cases.evidence: Header table masks known sensitive cells, but explicit Bulk Edit serializes originals to editor. Label now says Bulk Edit (unmasked). Request values remain intact.
cases.next_step: Native visual verification; decide whether a separate reveal control is required for this explicit edit surface.

cases.title: Browser preview leaves plaintext response in temporary HTML
cases.status: Source-confirmed; OPEN
cases.evidence: Explicit browser preview writes full response to predictable PID/time-named temp HTML with no lifecycle cleanup. It can retain response secrets outside encrypted SQLite. No browser execution or execution payload test performed.
cases.next_step: Use exclusive private temporary storage, track/clean lifecycle and make unmasked browser export explicit. Do not treat SQLite encryption as protecting these files.

cases.title: Large auth input enters unbounded text shaping
cases.status: Bounded/masked guard compiled and regression suite passed; native visual/timing check OPEN
cases.evidence: All auth values entered text_input directly even when large/multiline. Input now uses existing INLINE_LIMIT policy; large secure values render only mask plus clear action; original state preserved. No real OOM or GUI stress test run.
cases.next_step: Native visual check and small-limit model verification; confirm no secret hover/preview path.

cases.title: History URL and hover tooltip expose query/userinfo secrets
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: History label/tooltip formerly received raw entry.url. Synthetic regression failed. Presentation now masks userinfo, sensitive decoded query keys and fragments, bounds long URLs, and preserves stored/wire URL. Test passed including percent-encoded key and templated URL. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Full regression and native hover verification; sensitive-name heuristic is not a universal URL secret detector.

cases.title: Automatic snippet preview exposes password form fields
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Preview masked auth fields but not password URLencoded/multipart fields. Synthetic regression failed. Preview now masks credential-named form fields, URL secrets, and recognized JSON fields. Explicit unmasked copy and original request remain unchanged. Form regression passed. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Expand JSON/GraphQL/opaque-body tests. Unknown or encoded secrets cannot be universally inferred.

cases.title: Environment editor displays unmasked variable values
cases.status: Source observed; policy decision remains
cases.evidence: Dedicated environment editing table accepts/shows original values, unlike sensitive-name URL popup preview. User clarified initial concern was storage, not blanket UI masking. Do not label intended direct editing as an exploit without a secret/reveal policy.
cases.next_step: Consider explicit secret metadata/reveal mode; do not erase values or replace stored originals with masks.

cases.title: Snippet display cap applies after full generation
cases.status: Source-confirmed processing path; OPEN
cases.evidence: Preview copies/normalizes full editor body and generates snippet synchronously before clipping display to 64 KiB. Rendering cap alone does not bound CPU/temporary allocations for large imported inputs. No destructive stress test run.
cases.next_step: Bound preview construction before parsing/generation or add cancellable single-flight background work with revision checks; test small thresholds.

cases.title: WebSocket UI history and event buffers retain excessive data
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: 1100 small synthetic messages exceeded intended retention; baseline had no history cap. Now latest 500 messages/1 MiB retained, per-message preview64 KiB with explicit truncation, service/subscription event channels4. Wire message cap remains8 MiB. No OOM workload run. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Retention and source-tab tests passed. Per-frame/per-connection preview bounds do not certify global runtime queue/process memory. Same-tab connection epochs remain separate.

cases.title: Script console renders unbounded accumulated output
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: A 200 KB synthetic log entered editor without bound; regression failed. Visible console now retains64 KiB/max500 records with line cap and truncation marker, after secret redaction. No GUI freeze/OOM triggered. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Console retention tests passed. This caps retained/rendered output, not allocations inside script engine or complete process memory. Native visual/CPU benchmarking remains separate.

cases.title: WebSocket events update active tab instead of source tab
cases.status: Fix verified on Windows; see case limitations and remaining gates
cases.evidence: Handshake carried tab ID, but text/disconnect/error messages lost identity and mutated active_tab_mut. Events now carry source tab ID and ignore closed tabs. New regression checks inactive source routing and closed source. Final checks: default suite 361 passed/3 ignored; feature-disabled suite 337 passed/3 ignored; production cargo check passed. Independent read-only review found no critical/important introduced regressions in reviewed changes.
cases.next_step: Tab routing/closed-tab tests passed. Same-tab reconnect generation race remains OPEN: tab ID alone cannot distinguish old/new connections.
